questions.stem: In which significant year did the First Battle of Panipat take place, officially marking the beginning of the Mughal Empire in India?
questions.explanation: The First Battle of Panipat was fought on 21 April 1526 between the invading forces of Babur and the Lodi Empire, leading to the foundation of the Mughal Empire. 1556 was the Second Battle, and 1761 was the Third.

questions.stem: Babur decisively defeated which reigning Delhi Sultan in the First Battle of Panipat?
questions.explanation: Ibrahim Lodi was the last ruler of the Lodi dynasty and the last Sultan of Delhi. He was defeated and killed on the battlefield by Babur's forces.

questions.stem: In the crucial Battle of Khanwa (1527), Babur famously defeated which powerful Rajput ruler, effectively securing his control over northern India?
questions.explanation: Rana Sanga (Sangram Singh) of Mewar assembled a massive confederacy of Rajput rulers and Afghan allies to oust Babur. Babur defeated him at Khanwa, firmly establishing Mughal rule beyond just Delhi and Agra.

questions.stem: Before invading the Indian subcontinent, Zahir-ud-din Muhammad Babur was originally the young ruler of which specific Central Asian territory?
questions.explanation: Babur inherited the small valley kingdom of Fergana (in present-day Uzbekistan) at the age of 12. Though he captured Kabul later to use as a base, Fergana was his ancestral home.

questions.stem: In the Battle of Chanderi (1528), Babur defeated which prominent Rajput chief who was a close ally of Rana Sanga?
questions.explanation: Medini Rai was the powerful Rajput ruler of Chanderi. Babur attacked Chanderi to crush the remaining Rajput resistance after the Battle of Khanwa. Upon defeat, the Rajput women committed Jauhar.
